It is attained exactly when both D,S are positive or both are zero. When both are positive the unique minimizer is D/sqrt(S); when both are zero every positive eta minimizes; when exactly one vanishes the infimum0 is unattained. Theorem4.14 displayed minimum must therefore be read as infimum in the one-zero regimes. S is the energy realized by the single adaptive run, frozen during this scalar comparison; no optimal rerun or clairvoyant learner is asserted.
